finding: DurableQueue.submit used RegExp.test(commit) without a string type guard; boxed String and custom toString objects could be accepted as SHA-like identities, mutate the journal and disrupt strict exact-commit review.
fix: Require primitive string before exact 40-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA regex and before append.
